message: Assert used for invariant checking must include a message

evaluator_config.message_template: Assert without message — document the invariant being checked

rationale: Assert is for internal invariants during development, not for requiring every function to contain asserts (that conflicts with SC-007). When an assert is present, it must carry a human-readable invariant message. Functions without asserts are not violations.
remediation: Add a message: assert condition, 'invariant: ...'. Prefer Result.failure for input validation (SC-007).
